name: How does a local general contractor differ from a large restoration franchise?

mainEntity.name: How does a local general contractor differ from a large restoration franchise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Large disaster restoration franchises primarily focus on rapid mitigation—extracting water, placing industrial dehumidifiers, and performing rapid demolition. However, they frequently subcontract the actual reconstruction or leave homeowners searching for a separate remodeling contractor to finish the drywall, trim, tile, and paint. An owner-operated general contractor like HH Remodeling provides end-to-end continuity. Abraham Becerra manages both the emergency tear-out and the precision finish carpentry, ensuring that replacement drywall, moldings, and flooring match your home's original aesthetic without handoffs between multiple companies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Franchises focus mainly on water extraction and rapid demo, whereas a local contractor handles both stabilization and high-end reconstruction through final paint.
